method: 96 frames, the 7 Jul cull survivors in selects/Cesky Krumlov. 600px sheets for all; 69 at 1000px; 100% crops on 28 subjects, sky dust checked on five. Instagram: no Český Krumlov post.

frames.critique: The classic view from the viewpoint: the river bend, St Jošt, the tower, good sky. The lamp post runs from the bottom edge up into the town right of centre and a white tent roof sits bottom right: the postcard with a pole through it. On the site before.
Layered: the yellow wall, the Hotel Mlýn's salmon block, St Jošt, the tower, deep blue sky. Built well, but 'hotel mlýn' is lettered across the middle and the hotel takes the bottom half.
The viewpoint terrace: a tree frames left, people at the wall give scale, the tower and St Jošt stacked. The bottom 40% is lawn and shadowed path. On the site before.

frames.focus: sharp at 0.68,0.25 (the tower; the people on its gallery readable)
frames.critique: St Jošt stands right in front of the castle tower, the roofs lead in from the bottom, streaked blue sky. The best of the views from inside the town. Two parked cars bottom left. Sky clean of dust at 0.40,0.12.
Masná: the boulders and the red street sign frame a narrow lane, the tower at the end in a slot of sky. A sticker-covered drainpipe at right.
(sheet only) St Vitus from below, converging verticals: documentary.

The square: gables, the green house, the plague column in clean light, a few people. Well balanced, but a record of the square. Mihail at review: documentary more than a good shot; 7584 does the scene much better. Out.
(sheet only) the square wider, more people: 7476 is the pick.
Latrán to the tower on its rock, flags, pink flowers. A woman cut off at the bottom-left corner pulls the eye. On the site before.
An empty warm lane, shadow down the middle; parked cars at the far end. Quiet, little to hold the eye.
Restaurant terraces under St Vitus: Coca-Cola umbrellas front and centre, a white gazebo, a jumble of roofs. Busy without a centre.
(sheet only) a man on the bench under the stairs, signs everywhere: a stranger as the subject, busy.
Latrán's street to the green gabled house, a couple walking away; a Starbucks roundel mid-left, the bottom third shadowed cobbles. Pleasant, ordinary. On the site before.
A brass lantern top left, the stepped lane falling away, St Jošt's tower and St Vitus's spire above the roofs, warm light. Layered and particular to the place.
The bear in the moat from the bridge: dappled wall, the bear small, head down; the wall edge out of focus bottom left. A moment more than a picture.
The town and the river bend from the castle, St Vitus in the middle: the establishing view, but a pale sky and the bend cut at bottom left. 7542 and 7605 do it better. On the site before.
The vertical of 7492 with a raft on the river; a third of the frame pale sky.
(sheet only) the tower over a plain white wing that fills the left half.
The painted courtyard through the dark arch, people at the stall; the arch is a black wedge top left. 7609 (17:17) is warmer and cleaner.

frames.focus: sharp at 0.50,0.30 (St Vitus's clocks), a little haze at distance
frames.critique: The town through the stone window of the cloak bridge: the arch frames St Vitus, the pink and white houses and the weir. The framing earns it. Hazy sky. On the site before.
(sheet only) the copper beeches down the avenue: flat noon, empty gravel.
The castle garden: a couple walking away between clipped yews, the beeches and the fountain at the end. Symmetric and calm; the bottom third is empty gravel. Strangers.
(sheet only) the cloak bridge's arches from the garden road, empty tarmac the bottom half.
The theatre in candle light, warmer than 7511, but phones raised bottom right and a white pillar at left.

frames.focus: sharp enough at 0.42,0.78 (the costume sequins); high-ISO noise in the shadows, fine at display size
frames.critique: The Baroque theatre's stage square on: painted clouds, the wings, two costumes, candelabra either side. A rare thing, cleanly shown. On the site before.
Under the stage: timber shafts, capstan wheels, ropes on the tiles. Strong texture and lines; dim and a little muddy. Mihail at review: an interesting thing to shoot, but meh as a photo. Out.

frames.focus: soft-ish at 0.47,0.38 (the painted ceiling): high ISO in a dim box, detail mush at 100%, fine at display size
frames.critique: A box from below: red velvet drapes, the painted ceiling, rocaille, a candle sconce. Rich and well filled. Mihail at review: not high-ISO mush so much as a weak photo; 4★ was wrong. Out.

frames.focus: not resolved: the crop at 0.21,0.75 landed on the floor plinth (noisy, resolved); the figures look right at 1000px
frames.critique: The rock-cut passage: globe lamps, the bronze figures down the path, arches. Warm and strange. A framed print at the left edge is a small distraction. On the site before. Mihail at review: not that interesting or well shot. Out.
From the castle tower straight down the street to the bridge, people on it; the parapet cuts the bottom-right corner, pale sky. The street as a line works.
Roofs from the tower down to the river: dormers, a yellow house, the river curving top right, no sky. Graphic and full of colour. On the site before.
Down into the castle's second courtyard: the fountain, the linden, a few walkers; roofs crowd the bottom, grey sky, the new town's blocks top right.
The castle's whole length on its rock from the tower, the dormered roof below leading in, the river and the footbridge at left. Explains the castle in one frame; flat sky.
(sheet only) the castle wall over the river bend, a dark tower edge cutting in at left.
Straight down on Latrán and the river bend: roofs, terraces, the footbridge, a raft. Dense and textured, no sky.
St Vitus at the left edge over the roofs, the hills and the new town's blocks behind, flat white sky a third of the frame. No centre. On the site before; 7533 does the tower view better.
St Jošt's green dome in the corner, the river, the yellow house and St Vitus: the dome gives the view a foreground. The pale sky kept small.
(sheet only) the vertical, the dome at the corner and half white sky.
The castle chapel: red carpet up the steps, the altarpiece, the gold sunburst in the vault. Symmetric, a little flat.
St Vitus through the castle window's bars: a good idea, but the bars cut the church and half the panes are white sky.
The coffered ceiling with gilt rosettes, two portraits at the bottom edge. Rich pattern, tilted perspective.

The golden carriage, warm orange curtains, portraits. The top third is a plain ceiling and a stanchion stands at left. Mihail at review: not interesting or well shot, the weakest of the castle rooms. Out.
The Masquerade Hall: the painted crowd on the walls and the chandeliers, but rows of chairs fill the bottom third and a light stand sits mid-right.

frames.focus: sharp at 0.29,0.15 (St Vitus's spire); sky at 0.70,0.10 clean
frames.critique: The view from the cloak bridge's window at 13:58 without the arch: the whole old town, St Vitus, the pink house, the weir, broken cloud with blue. The clearest view of the town all day.
Roofs packed under St Vitus, a Budvar awning at the bottom edge. A near-twin of 7604.
The castle tower at left, St Jošt, the river curving out of the bottom left, the town to the right, cloud with patches of blue. Castle, river and town in one.
The cloak bridge's arcades and the sgraffito wing above the gorge, grey sky. A solid record.
Pink roses over the café garden, the people behind soft. Pretty, nothing more.

frames.focus: the walker is soft at 0.55,0.89 (small, moving); the bridge is the subject and holds at 1000px
frames.critique: The cloak bridge from below: three tiers of arches, the statues, a walker small under the gate. Monumental. Red-and-white tape at bottom left. Mihail at review: likes it but doesn’t love it, down to 3; 7579 may show the bridge better. Parked for 7579.
The castle over the river, the footbridge with people leaning, a green raft with two men. Good layering; the raft is drab and the bridge halves the frame. 7602 is the same view, better.
(sheet only) as 7555 without the raft up close.

frames.focus: sharp enough at 0.52,0.70 (the altarpiece), high-ISO noise
frames.critique: St Vitus inside: the net vault fans over the nave to the gilded high altar, stained glass either side. Symmetric, warm. A man's head bottom right.

A narrow lane, the yellow wall at left, the tower in a slot of sky with a patch of blue, the Hotel Peregrin sign. The same idea as 7473, less framed. Beats 7622. Mihail at review: drop it: one tower lane too many.
St Jošt before the castle under heavy grey cloud: 7469 in other weather. Moody, but the roofs in front are dull and the sky is the only change.
Stairs up through a white arch to a wooden door, a pension sign, a lantern. Quiet geometry, grey light.
Workshop Alley through the yellow arch: a Picasso A-board, a café board and a luggage sign fill the corners. Reads like a street advert.
The painted wing and tower above the river, a red raft and a pink ring in the rapids; half the frame is willow and bank, flat sky.
The river under the flower terrace to St Jošt, rapids, people at the terrace; dark wall bottom right. Pleasant. On the site before.

frames.focus: sharp at 0.40,0.84 (the unicorn); the woman on it is recognisable at 100%, small at display size
frames.critique: The castle wall over the river and, below it, canoes and an inflatable unicorn. Wit and scale in one frame: the wall is huge, the river is a holiday. A heavy green middle; moored canoes clip the bottom left. Mihail at review: a 3, even though the unicorn is fun.

The cloak bridge from the street, but a stickered signpost and a bin are the foreground and the sky is grey. On the site before. Mihail at review: an interesting and good frame, potentially better at the cloak bridge than 7554; up to 3. In, as his pick.

The square at 16:50: warm light on the gables and the plague column, a textured sky, people walking. At 1000px the cloud shadow in the foreground leads to the lit facades instead of spoiling it. Sheet-only 2★ at the first look, for that shadow; Mihail at review: much better than 7476. Up to 3, in.
(sheet only) the coral house on the square, half the frame empty paving.
The narrowest lane: rough wall in shadow, sun on the yellow arch, the grille's wavy shadow on the sill, a red door and a lamp at the end. All texture and light. On the site before.
St Vitus's tower at the end of a lane, white laundry strung across it, the red wall at right, two people at the menu board. Lived-in, sun and cloud.
The canoe landing below Latrán: the yellow house, canoes in the foreground, people paddling. Lively but scattered; flat sky.
Canoeists on the river towards the bridge, a rail at right. The men in the foreground raft are the subject and they aren't interesting. On the site before.
(sheet only) St Vitus's spire over a house across the river: plain, much sky and dark water.

The castle and the cloak bridge across the river, wild roses in the foreground, a kayak passing, warm light on the orange house. The crop shows how close the kayaker is: a sunburnt back in a vest in the bottom corner. On the site before.
The castle, the tower and Rybářská's houses mirrored in still water, sunlit clouds. The best river frame; the weir's concrete step at bottom left is a blemish.

The weir sweeps diagonally into the frame towards the white tower house; the castle wing, the tower and the footbridge behind, sunlit clouds. The water gives the town a foreground. A rail at the bottom edge.
The weir straight on under the terrace houses, St Vitus's spire. Orderly; the weir is a band across the bottom and nothing leads in.
The yellow raft under the footbridge, the castle and tower above, people along the bridge, warmer than 7555. On the site before.

frames.focus: sharp at 0.44,0.59 (the raft and its poles)
frames.critique: Down on the river from the castle garden: the footbridge, a wooden raft, canoes, St Jošt and the tower over everything. Deep and full of small life.
Roofs packed under St Vitus at 17:11, the Budvar awning at the bottom again. A near-twin of 7546; 7605 and 7542 say more. On the site before.
All three landmarks: the castle tower at left, St Jošt, St Vitus at right, the roofs between and the river at the edge. The most complete view of the town.
The painted courtyard at 17:17: sgraffito, frescoed figures, the oriel, the arch with children and a father below. Warmer and cleaner than 7496.
The river bend at 17:18, vertical; half the frame pale sky. On the site before; 7542 and 7605 replace it.
The second courtyard to the tower, two walkers in red and orange crossing; a stone ball bottom left, sky half the frame.
The fountain under the tower, the sgraffito wing, one walker at left. Cleaner than 7612.
The castle on its rock from below; a lamp post through the house roof in front, heads at the bottom edge.
A long lane to the tower on its rock, people small far down. Deep, but the walls are blank at this hour.
The yellow lane at 17:29: a sticker-covered pipe takes a strip at right, grey sky. 7564 wins.
